senses.gloss: m. pl. (= מזמזט׳, transpos. of זמזם, v. זַמְזוּמֵי; cmp. גִעְגֵּע for עגעג; as to זט for זז cmp. גִּיסְטְרָא, גְּזוּזְטְרָא) music, sweet melodies.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 36:11">Targ. Job XXXVI, 11</cite> (Ms. <cite ref="B00994"><he>בסימיא</he></cite>; h. text <he>נעימים</he>).—Hebr. constr. <he>מַזְמוּטֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Chagigah 14b:5">Ḥag. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ חתן וכלה</he> the musical entertainments at a wedding (Y. ib. II, 77ᵃ bot. <he>בני חופה שמיחין לפני חתן</he>).
